requirements.quote: The Contractor agrees to complete and submit these forms without change in response to goals specified in the Request for Proposal (RFP) or contract.
requirements.text: Submit required SRAA forms as specified in the RFP or contract.

requirements.quote: Failure to comply with all of the requirements herein may result in a finding of non-responsiveness, non-responsibility and/or breach of contract, leading to the withholding of funds or such other actions, liquidated damages pursuant to Section VII of the Appendix or enforcement proceedings allowed by the Contract.
requirements.text: Non-compliance may result in penalties, including withholding of funds or contract breach.

requirements.quote: For purposes of this procurement, the SRAA hereby establishes an overall goal of thirty percent (30%) for Minority and Women-Owned Business Enterprises (MWBE) participation. Additionally, an overall goal of ten to twenty percent (10-20%) is established for Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) participation.
requirements.text: Meet 30% MWBE and 10-20% EEO participation goals.

requirements.quote: Contractor should reference the directory of New York State Certified MBWEs found at the following internet address: https://ny.newnycontracts.com/FrontEnd/VendorSearchPublic.asp
requirements.text: Use the NY State Certified MWBE directory for participation.

requirements.quote: Contractor is encouraged to contact the Division of Minority and Women’s Business Development at (518) 292-5250, (212) 803-2414 or (716) 846-8200 to discuss additional methods of maximizing participation by MWBEs on the Contract.
requirements.text: Contact DMWBD for assistance in maximizing MWBE participation.

requirements.quote: Where MWBE goals have been established herein, pursuant to 5 NYCRR § 142.8, Contractor must document “good faith efforts” to provide meaningful participation by MWBEs as subcontractors and suppliers in the performance of the Contract.
requirements.text: Document good faith efforts to include MWBEs as subcontractors and suppliers.

requirements.quote: Contractor acknowledges that if Contractor is found to have willfully and intentionally failed to comply with the MWBE participation goals set forth in the Contract, such a finding constitutes a breach of contract and the Contractor shall be liable to the SRAA for liquidated or other appropriate damages, as set forth herein.
requirements.text: Non-compliance with MWBE goals may result in breach of contract and damages.

requirements.quote: As a condition of the Contract, the Contractor and SRAA agree to be bound by the provisions of § 316 of Article 15-A of the New York State Executive Law regarding enforcement.
requirements.text: Agree to provisions of § 316 of Article 15-A for enforcement.

requirements.quote: SRAA reserves the right to establish separate and different goals on any State Contract, as identified in the specified procurement.
requirements.text: SRAA may set different goals for specific contracts.

requirements.quote: Contractor agrees to be bound by the provisions of Article 15-A and the MWBE Regulations promulgated by the DMWBD.
requirements.text: Comply with Article 15-A and MWBE regulations.
